attributes.description: Inventory Shadow AI tools on Windows endpoints — local LLMs, AI coding agents, AI desktop applications, MCP servers (MCP config file presence, metadata only), AI model files, Python/npm AI packages, browser extensions, Docker containers, Windows services, scheduled tasks, AI API key exposure, and AI tool configuration directories, vector databases, and model cache sizes.
attributes.name: ai-asset-discovery-windows

queries.query:
SELECT
    name,
    path,
    cmdline,
    pid,
    username,
    resident_size,
    start_time,
    ppid,
    category
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.name,
        p.path,
        p.cmdline,
        p.pid,
        u.username,
        p.resident_size,
        datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time,
        p.parent AS ppid,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server-%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp_server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%fastmcp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%modelcontextprotocol%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%smithery%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcpx%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-run%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%glama%mcp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-proxy%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-gateway%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supergateway%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github-mcp-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol/server-%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-remote%'
    OR p.name IN ('github-mcp-server', 'mcp-server-github')) THEN 'mcp'
            WHEN (p.name IN ('claude', 'claude.exe', 'cursor', 'cursor.exe', 'windsurf', 'windsurf.exe', 'warp', 'warp.exe', 'zed', 'zed.exe', 'tabnine', 'tabnine.exe', 'TabNine', 'TabNine.exe', 'WasmTabNine', 'WasmTabNine.exe', 'codeium_language_server', 'codeium_language_server.exe', 'supermaven', 'supermaven.exe', 'amazon-q', 'amazon-q.exe', 'pieces-os', 'pieces-os.exe', 'Pieces OS', 'Pieces OS.exe', 'codex', 'codex.exe', 'aider', 'aider.exe', 'sgpt', 'sgpt.exe', 'augment', 'augment.exe', 'goose', 'goose.exe', 'devin', 'devin.exe', 'gemini-cli', 'gemini-cli.exe', 'genaiscript', 'genaiscript.exe', 'opencode', 'opencode.exe', 'kiro', 'kiro.exe', 'kilocode', 'kilocode.exe', 'Odr.exe', 'copilot-agent.exe')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@anthropic/claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@anthropic-ai/claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude_desktop%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%com.anthropic.claudedesktop%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Cursor.app%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Cursor Helper%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Windsurf%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium_language_server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium%enterprise%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%copilot-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%copilot-language-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@openai/codex%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%aider-chat%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%aider%--model%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%saoudrizwan.claude-dev%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%continue.continue%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%continuedev%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codewhisperer%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%AmazonWebServices.amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sourcegraph.cody%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabnine%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.warp.Warp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.zed.Zed%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell_gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%swe-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pieces-os%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supermaven%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%augment%code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openai/codex%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%goose%session%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%autogpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%auto-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%babyagi%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%agentgpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%crewai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic-kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic_kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-index%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama_index%'
    
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%opencode%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kilocode%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vscodium%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kiro%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@cursor/agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-cli%') THEN 'agent'
            WHEN (p.name IN ('ollama', 'ollama.exe', 'lms', 'lms.exe', 'gpt4all', 'gpt4all.exe', 'jan', 'jan.exe', 'msty', 'msty.exe', 'local-ai', 'local-ai.exe', 'koboldcpp', 'koboldcpp.exe', 'llama-server', 'llama-server.exe', 'llama-cli', 'llama-cli.exe', 'vllm', 'vllm.exe', 'mlc_llm', 'mlc_llm.exe', 'mlc_chat', 'mlc_chat.exe', 'anythingllm', 'anythingllm.exe', 'anything-llm', 'anything-llm.exe', 'litellm', 'litellm.exe', 'open-webui', 'open-webui.exe', 'llamafile', 'llamafile.exe', 'text-generation-launcher', 'text-generation-launcher.exe', 'text-generation-router', 'text-generation-router.exe', 'comfyui', 'comfyui.exe', 'invokeai', 'invokeai.exe', 'Msty.exe', 'exo', 'exo.exe', 'tabby', 'tabby.exe', 'qwen', 'qwen.exe', 'grok', 'grok.exe')
    OR p.path LIKE '%\\Ollama\\%'
    OR p.path LIKE '%\\LM Studio\\%'
    OR p.path LIKE '%\\GPT4All\\%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm.entrypoints%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-launcher%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%koboldcpp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llamafile%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mlc_llm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%oobabooga%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%comfyui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%invokeai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%stable-diffusion-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%whisper%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%msty%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabby%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo-launcher%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cohere serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mistral serve%') THEN 'llm_runtime'
        END AS category
    FROM processes p
    LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
) AS ai_procs
WHERE category IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    l.port,
    l.address,
    l.protocol,
    p.name,
    p.path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid
FROM listening_ports l
JOIN processes p ON l.pid = p.pid
WHERE (
    l.port IN (11434, 1234, 7860)
    OR (
        l.port IN (43411, 4891, 1337, 5001, 8080, 8000, 4000, 3000, 3001, 8188, 9090, 1000, 8501, 8265, 9099, 5678, 8888)
        AND (
            p.name IN (
                'ollama', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'vllm', 'litellm', 'koboldcpp',
                'llama-server', 'llamafile', 'open-webui', 'anythingllm', 'comfyui',
                'invokeai',
                'claude', 'cursor', 'Cursor', 'windsurf', 'Windsurf',
                'copilot-agent', 'aider', 'codex', 'tabby', 'exo'
            )
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol%'
        )
    )
    OR (
        l.port = 18789
        AND (
            p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
            OR p.name LIKE '%openclaw%'
        )
    )
)
AND l.address != '127.0.0.1'
AND l.address != '::1';

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    install_location,
    publisher,
    install_date,
    CASE
        WHEN name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR name LIKE '%Copilot CLI%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN name LIKE '%Microsoft 365 Copilot%' OR name LIKE '%Copilot for Microsoft%' OR name LIKE '%Microsoft Copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN name LIKE '%Copilot%' THEN 'unknown'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS copilot_variant
FROM programs
WHERE name LIKE '%Ollama%' OR name LIKE '%LM Studio%' OR name LIKE '%ChatGPT%'
    OR name LIKE '%Claude%' OR name LIKE '%Cursor%' OR name LIKE '%GPT4All%'
    OR name LIKE '%Perplexity%' OR name LIKE '%Windsurf%' OR name LIKE '%DeepSeek%'
    OR name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR name LIKE '%Jan AI%' OR name LIKE '%Msty%'
    OR name LIKE '%AnythingLLM%' OR name LIKE '%Open WebUI%'
    OR name LIKE '%Warp%' OR name LIKE '%Zed%' OR name LIKE '%Poe%'
    OR name LIKE '%Amazon Q%' OR name LIKE '%Pieces%'
    OR name LIKE '%Codeium%' OR name LIKE '%Tabnine%'
    OR name LIKE '%DiffusionBee%' OR name LIKE '%ComfyUI%'
    OR name LIKE '%LiteLLM%' OR name LIKE '%Qwen%'
    OR name LIKE '%Grok%'
    OR name LIKE '%Gemini%'
    OR name LIKE '%Replit%'
    OR name LIKE '%Ghostwriter%'
    OR name LIKE '%Bito%'
;

SELECT
    path,
    size,
    type,
    username,
    modified_time,
    accessed_time,
    config_kind
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.path,
        f.size,
        f.type,
        u.username,
        datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
        datetime(f.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
        CASE
            WHEN (f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Roaming\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.claude.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.claude\settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cursor\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.vscode\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.mcp.json'
OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\.kiro\\settings\\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\.codeium\\windsurf\\mcp_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\.gemini\\settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\.codex\\config.toml'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\.config\\opencode\\opencode.json'

    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\Documents\\%\\.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\Projects\\%\\.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\dev\\%\\.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\src\\%\\.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\repos\\%\\.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\code\\%\\.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\Documents\\%\\.vscode\\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\Projects\\%\\.vscode\\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\dev\\%\\.vscode\\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\src\\%\\.vscode\\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\repos\\%\\.vscode\\mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%\\code\\%\\.vscode\\mcp.json') THEN 'mcp_config'
            WHEN ((
    f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ollama\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\lm-studio\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\huggingface\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\gpt4all\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\llama.cpp\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\jan\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.continue\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cursor\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.codeium\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.tabnine\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.claude\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.config\github-copilot\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.config\shell_gpt\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.supermaven\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.anythingllm\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.invokeai\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\LM Studio\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\AnythingLLM\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\Ollama\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\GPT4All\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Roaming\Jan\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\Pieces\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\Cursor\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.gemini\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.codex\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.kiro\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.config\opencode\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.openclaw\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.lmstudio\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.hermes\%'
    OR f.path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.kilocode\%'
)
AND f.type = 'directory') THEN 'tool_directory'
        END AS config_kind
    FROM file f
    LEFT JOIN users u ON f.uid = u.uid
) AS ai_config
WHERE config_kind IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    path,
    filename,
    size,
    datetime(mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
    datetime(atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    CASE
        WHEN path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ollama\models\%' THEN 'ollama'
        WHEN path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.lmstudio\%' THEN 'lm-studio'
        WHEN path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\huggingface\%' THEN 'huggingface'
        WHEN path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\llama.cpp\%' THEN 'llama.cpp'
        WHEN path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\nomic.ai\GPT4All\%' THEN 'gpt4all'
        WHEN path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\Downloads\%' THEN 'download'
        ELSE 'other'
    END AS tool
FROM file
WHERE (
    path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ollama\models\blobs\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ollama\models\%\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.lmstudio\models\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.lmstudio\models\%\%\%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\huggingface\hub\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\huggingface\hub\%\%\%.safetensors'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\llama.cpp\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\llama.cpp\%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\nomic.ai\GPT4All\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\nomic.ai\GPT4All\%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\Downloads\%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\Downloads\%.safetensors'
)
AND size > 104857600;

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    directory
FROM python_packages
WHERE name IN (
    'torch', 'tensorflow', 'onnxruntime', 'jax', 'flax',
    'transformers', 'diffusers', 'accelerate', 'peft', 'trl',
    'huggingface-hub', 'tokenizers', 'datasets', 'sentence-transformers',
    'safetensors',
    'openai', 'anthropic', 'google-generativeai', 'cohere', 'replicate',
    'groq', 'mistralai', 'together', 'fireworks-ai', 'deepseek-sdk',
    'langchain', 'langchain-core', 'langchain-community',
    'llama-index', 'llama-index-core',
    'autogen', 'crewai', 'semantic-kernel', 'haystack-ai', 'dspy-ai',
    'instructor', 'guidance', 'outlines',
    'llama-cpp-python', 'ollama', 'vllm', 'ctransformers',
    'bitsandbytes', 'auto-gptq', 'exllama',
    'fastmcp', 'mcp',
    'chromadb', 'qdrant-client', 'weaviate-client', 'pinecone-client',
    'pymilvus', 'faiss-cpu', 'faiss-gpu',
    'aider-chat', 'shell-gpt', 'mentat',
    'gradio', 'streamlit',
    'openai-whisper', 'whisper', 'elevenlabs', 'bark',
    'litellm',
    'llm'
);

SELECT
    ce.name,
    ce.identifier,
    ce.version,
    ce.description,
    ce.path,
    ce.state,
    u.username,
    CASE
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%github%copilot%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%Microsoft%Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%microsoft%copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%copilot%' THEN 'browser'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS copilot_variant
FROM users u CROSS JOIN chrome_extensions ce USING(uid)
WHERE ce.state = 1 AND (
    ce.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR ce.name LIKE '%ChatGPT%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Claude%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Gemini%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Perplexity%' OR ce.name LIKE '%DeepSeek%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Monica%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Merlin%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Sider%' OR ce.name LIKE '%MaxAI%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%UseChatGPT%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Poe%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Cody%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Codeium%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Tabnine%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Blackbox%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Phind%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Bito%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Grammarly%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Jasper%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Wordtune%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Quillbot%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%QuillBot%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Compose AI%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Writesonic%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Copy.ai%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%You.com%' OR ce.name LIKE '%AIPRM%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%WebChatGPT%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Glasp%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Eightify%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%NoteGPT%' OR ce.name LIKE '%tl;dv%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%DeepL%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Immersive Translate%'
    OR ce.identifier IN (
        'fjoaledfpmneenckfbpdfhkmimnjocfa',
        'ngjjaadpdmddgbpmipagccngfbpmekei',
        'hcmjdjeeoimlofdjmfpbpamldmmiifne',
        'eollffkcakepchajholpcojldgkiikmf',
        'kbbdabhdfibfiedgpfkhdnbdilnjohlm',
        'aajjgdpofhhcffcgighomdiodecghjdd'
    )
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%chatgpt%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%copilot%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%claude%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%perplexity%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%deepseek%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%openai%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%anthropic%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%codeium%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%tabnine%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%grammarly%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%deepl%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%monica%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%sider%'
);

SELECT
    p.name,
    p.path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid,
    datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS started_at
FROM processes p
WHERE (p.name IN ('docker.exe', 'docker', 'podman.exe', 'podman'))
    AND (p.cmdline LIKE '%docker run%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%docker compose%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%docker-compose%')
    AND (
    p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pytorch%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tensorflow%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%triton%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%huggingface%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%modelcontextprotocol%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%fastmcp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%flowise%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%langflow%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%chromadb%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%chroma%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%qdrant%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%weaviate%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%milvus%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pinecone%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%comfyui%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%stable-diffusion%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%invokeai%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%automatic1111%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%n8n%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sweepai%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pr-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%qwen%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%grok%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cohere%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mistral%'
    );

SELECT
    name,
    display_name,
    path,
    start_type,
    status,
    user_account
FROM services
WHERE name LIKE '%ollama%' OR name LIKE '%lmstudio%'
    OR name LIKE '%anythingllm%' OR name LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR name LIKE '%pieces%' OR name LIKE '%comfyui%'
    OR display_name LIKE '%Ollama%' OR display_name LIKE '%LM Studio%'
    OR display_name LIKE '%AnythingLLM%' OR display_name LIKE '%LiteLLM%'
    OR display_name LIKE '%Pieces%'
    OR path LIKE '%ollama%' OR path LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR path LIKE '%llama-server%' OR path LIKE '%anythingllm%';

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    description,
    path,
    directory,
    depth
FROM npm_packages
WHERE (
    name LIKE '@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR name LIKE 'mcp-server-%'
    OR name LIKE '@anthropic-ai/%'
    OR name LIKE '@elastic/mcp%'
    OR name LIKE '@github/mcp-server%'
    OR name LIKE 'mcp-remote%'
    OR name LIKE '@openai/%'
    OR name LIKE '@google/gemini-cli%'
    OR name LIKE '@google/generative-ai%'
    OR name LIKE '@google-cloud/vertexai%'
    OR name LIKE '@langchain/%'
    OR name LIKE 'langchain%'
    OR name LIKE '@continuedev/%'
    OR name LIKE '@mistralai/%'
    OR name LIKE '@cohere/%'
    OR name LIKE '@githubnext/%copilot%'
    OR name LIKE '@github/copilot%'
    OR name LIKE 'gemini-cli%'
)
AND depth = 0;

SELECT
    fa.name,
    fa.identifier,
    fa.version,
    fa.description,
    fa.path,
    fa.active,
    u.username,
    CASE
        WHEN fa.name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR fa.identifier LIKE '%github%copilot%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN fa.name LIKE '%Microsoft%Copilot%' OR fa.identifier LIKE '%microsoft%copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN fa.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR fa.identifier LIKE '%copilot%' THEN 'browser'
        ELSE NULL

        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%\.cache\huggingface%' THEN 'huggingface'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%\.cache\lm-studio%' THEN 'lm-studio'
    END AS ai_tool,
    CASE
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%\.ollama\models%' THEN 'C:\Users\*\.ollama\models'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%\.cache\huggingface%' THEN 'C:\Users\*\.cache\huggingface'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%\.cache\lm-studio%' THEN 'C:\Users\*\.cache\lm-studio'
    END AS cache_path,
    SUM(f.size) AS total_bytes,
    COUNT(*) AS file_count
FROM file f
WHERE (
    f.directory LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ollama\models%'
    OR f.directory LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\huggingface%'
    OR f.directory LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\lm-studio%'
)
    AND f.type = 'regular'
GROUP BY ai_tool
HAVING total_bytes > 104857600;

SELECT

    p.pid,
    u.username,
    sens.path AS sensitive_file_path,
    sens.size AS sensitive_file_size,
    datetime(sens.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    datetime(sens.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time

SELECT
    p.name AS process_name,
    p.path AS process_path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    pos.remote_address,
    pos.remote_port,
    pos.local_port,
    pos.local_address,
    pos.state,
    CASE pos.family
        WHEN 2 THEN 'IPv4'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'IPv6'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS address_family,
    CASE pos.protocol
        WHEN 6 THEN 'tcp'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'udp'
        ELSE CAST(pos.protocol AS TEXT)
    END AS transport_protocol,
    CASE
        WHEN pos.remote_address LIKE '10.%' OR pos.remote_address LIKE '192.168.%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_rfc1918_destination
    datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time
FROM process_open_sockets pos
JOIN processes p ON pos.pid = p.pid
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
WHERE pos.remote_address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '0.0.0.0', '::')
    AND pos.remote_address != ''
    AND (pos.state IN ('ESTABLISHED', 'CLOSE_WAIT', 'SYN_SENT') OR pos.state IS NULL)
    AND (
        p.name IN ('ollama.exe', 'claude.exe', 'Cursor.exe', 'windsurf.exe',
